name: DMM Bitcoin
rootCause: Centralized Japanese crypto exchange DMM Bitcoin exploited for more than $304 million in Bitcoin. What could go down as one of the biggest heists in our industry, became another prime example of not your keys, not your crypto.

descriptions.text: Centralized Japanese crypto exchange DMM Bitcoin exploited for more than $304 million in Bitcoin. What could go down as one of the biggest heists in our industry, became another prime example of not your keys, not your crypto.
DMM Bitcoin, a Japanese cryptocurrency exchange, announced it lost 48.2 billion yen ($305 million) worth of bitcoin (BTC) due to a hack.

DMM Bitcoin, a Japanese exchange, lost 4,502.9 BTC (~$308M) on May 31, 2024 after a North Korean social-engineering attack compromised wallet vendor Ginco’s signing session. All BTC was drained in one operation. The hot wallet’s architecture allowed a single compromised session to override withdrawal controls. DMM Bitcoin was forced to wind down and transfer accounts to SBI VC Trade. The attacker gained control of Ginco’s wallet management session through social-engineered phishing.
